title: Fewer photons, more hydrogen: effects of dynamic irradiation on light-driven hydrogen evolution by thiomolybdate catalysts
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1313-1320
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01490E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
S. Henriette Kolbinger, Laura Haxha, P. Charlotte Schröder, Daniel Kowalczyk, Luis Senz, Luca Schleicher, Arijit Mukherjee, Daniel Malcolm, Corinna L. Kufner, Dirk Ziegenbalg, Carsten Streb
Dynamic irradiation conditions are shown to result in a significant increase in reactivity in light-driven hydrogen evolution by thiomolybdates. Experimental and theoretical studies shed light on the underlying causes of this observation.
